## v1.42.0

**Upgrade now.** This version uses the per-session TURN credentials the server sends. The legacy TURN method is deprecated on 22 November 2026, and older SDK versions only use it. Apps on a pinned older tag lose relayed media after that date. No code change is needed: bump the tag and keep your `turnServerUrl` settings as they are.

Two things can change for existing apps. `mgmt.doctor` can show a new warning on existing agents, and a media channel that keeps failing now ends the session with `reconnect_failed`. See Behavior change.

### Added

- Per-session TURN credentials. The SDK reads the `turn` entry the server sends on connect and lists it first. Your `turnServerUrl` and `turnCredentials` (or the SDK defaults) follow as the fallback. A peer connects on whichever entry the relay accepts. (#424)
- A refused entry, or a 401 on a URL only that entry uses, is set aside for later peers, with one `[turn]` warning. (#424)
- Credentials about to expire are renewed on a fresh socket before the next relay allocation. (#424)
- No credential reaches logs, events, errors or `session.clientConfig`. (#424)
- `normalizeServerTurn` and `iceServersFor` are exported from `./experience`. (#424)
- Doctor warns (`api_tool_url_arg_unsafe`) when an api tool puts a `{arg}` placeholder in the host or path of its URL, or in a query value with more text after it. The server fills `{arg}` as is, so pass such values through your own endpoint. See [docs/DOCTOR.md](../../docs/DOCTOR.md#finding-codes). (#502)
- `test/fakes/socket.js` supports `onAny` and `offAny`, and `serverConnected` extends the `onServerConnected` payload. `test/fakes/rtc.js` supports `getConfiguration` and `setConfiguration`, and rejects a changed `bundlePolicy` like a real peer. (#424)

### Fixed

- The doctor's template-syntax stripping and the GenUI YAML key parser now run in linear time on long inputs. (#502)

### Changed

- `KalturaScriptedVideoSession` accepts `turn` as a host, `host:port`, full `turn:`/`turns:` URLs or a list, with `credential`, `password` or neither (the default credentials apply). A `turn:` URL with no port gets the standard ports and transports, as before. (#424)
- `initClient` returns `turn` with an optional `ttl` in seconds. Keep it out of logs. (#424)
- The socket connect query carries `sdk` with the SDK version. (#424)

### Behavior change

- A channel that needs a third recovery with no ICE up since the first one ends the session with `reconnect_failed`. Before, the mic uplink could keep recovering with no end. (#424)
- `mgmt.doctor` on an agent with an api tool that breaks the new URL rule now returns a `warn`. Tools that were fine before can show it, for example the direct Salesforce tools. An app that fails on any warning will fail on it. (#502)

### Docs and skill

- [docs/wire-protocol/audio-channels.md](../../docs/wire-protocol/audio-channels.md) describes the TURN sources, refusal and renewal. `SECURITY.md`, the pause and resume recipe and the event catalog cover the `turn` entry. (#424)
- `docs/api/build/tools-and-secrets.md` and `docs/EXTERNAL-API-INTEGRATIONS.md` say that the server puts an `{arg}` into a URL with no percent-encoding, and give the placeholder rules. A prompt cannot enforce encoding. (#502)
- `docs/DOCTOR.md` lists `api_tool_url_arg_unsafe`. (#502)
- `SECURITY.md` and the connection docs list the `sdk` connect query field. The recovery docs describe the per-channel limit and `reconnect_failed`. (#424)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kaltura/intelligent-agents-sdk/compare/v1.41.0...v1.42.0
